QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Surveying the Dead Mine
QuestInfo.0: Alcaster seems worried by what Scadur saw.

QuestInfo.2: The monsters are protected by an unknown barrier. Professor Moon explained that the barriers are called #e#rStar Force#k#n.
